description: Delete one task in the connected LoopGantt ACCOUNT (requires signing in to LoopGantt, or an API key) - and every task under it when it is a phase. DESTRUCTIVE: ask the user before calling, and pass confirm: true only after they agreed; without it nothing is deleted. It cannot be undone: the task (and every task under it) disappears from the app and cannot be restored; the deleted rows are purged after 30 days.

confirm.description: Must be true: the user has confirmed this deletion

name: delete_task
